notablePrerequisites: At least four quest counters on Quest for the Pure Flame.
easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Quest for the Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling damage sources you control will deal this turn.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you that does not change your life total due to Platinum Emperion.
